text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower brilliantly proved herself 
with great results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome home, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome home, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It feels a bit ticklish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if the blue rose from the 
picture book felt this way too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Ehehe... Big Brother. Do you 
remember the story of "The Blue Rose of 
Happiness"?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Ehehe... Big Sister. Do you 
remember the story of "The Blue Rose of 
Happiness"?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...The blue rose was displayed on the 
windowsill of Onii-sama's home, bringing 
happiness to all who passed by.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...The blue rose was displayed on the 
windowsill of Onee-sama's home, bringing 
happiness to all who passed by.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, Rice has learned so many things 
over these three years ...and made lots of 
new discoveries. Even in this picture 
book... that Rice has looked at for so 
long.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Until now, I thought that for roses, the 
windowsill was... the place where they'd 
be seen the most."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still... to the rose, by the window 
must've been the spot with the best view 
of all, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Of dear brother, returning home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Of dear sister, returning home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the rose was eagerly looking 
forward to it. ...To spending time with 
the most important person.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, dear Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Did Rice bloom beautifully? Do you 
still... want to display her?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm so happy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice also... wants to keep blooming 
together with you for a long time...!
